description: PR adds a CostCenter default tag and shortens the platform service log retention 30 -> 14 days (acceptable: a retention cut), and turns off storage encryption for the orders DB through a new root variable, which forces the database to be replaced.

material.why: storage_encrypted true -> false forces replacement of the production database: the plan destroys it and creates an empty one (data loss unless restored from a snapshot). As written the apply fails at the destroy (deletion_protection is true, and skip_final_snapshot is false with no final_snapshot_identifier), but the PR's intent is still to replace the database, and turning protection off to get past the error loses the data.
